Frontend nav.js has 'Booking' for Super Admin and 'Bookings' for Sales/Accounting — inconsistent label for the same route (/booking). Minor cosmetic.
The v1 signing helper (`n8n_auth`) uses timestamp skew ±300s and rate limit; consider surfacing the rate limit counter in api-logs for observability (currently only status/latency are captured).

rca of the issue: N/A — no failures.
